label: ZetaNine.ShortZeroCoefficient.weightedCoeff
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
value: fun n m r b j => n.choose j ^ r * ((j + m).choose m * (n - j + m).choose m) ^ b

label: ZetaNine.ShortZeroCoefficient.A
value: fun n m => 28 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1) ^ (m + j) * ↑(ZetaNine.ShortZeroCoefficient.weightedCoeff n m 3 7 j)

label: ZetaNine.ShortZeroCoefficient.A_even_signed_lower
type:
∀ (d m : ℕ),
  28 * ↑((2 * d).choose d) * ↑((3 * d).choose d) * ↑((d + m).choose m) ^ 14 ≤

label: ZetaNine.ShortZeroCoefficient.A_ne_zero_of_even
type: ∀ (n m : ℕ), Even n → ZetaNine.ShortZeroCoefficient.A n m ≠ 0
